item.description:

item.title: Court Orders Insurer to Pay 46,000 Yuan After Firing Employee Over AI Tool Use
item.description:
A Beijing court ruled that an insurer unlawfully fired a legal staffer for uploading work data to a third-party AI platform, since internal rules never banned such tools, set no AI-specific compliance policy and offered no related training. The company must reinstate her and pay over 46,000 yuan in lost wages and bonus differences; an appeal was rejected. The case offers a rare judicial reference for corporate AI-use compliance and labor-law boundaries in China.

原文标题：员工用第三方 AI 办公遭解雇 法院判公司赔偿 4.6 万

Why it matters：首例进入公众视野的“员工用 AI 被开除”判决，直接划定企业 AI 合规制度缺位时的责任边界。

item.title: AGENTS.md Becomes New Attack Vector, Silently Hijacking AI Coding Agents
item.description:
Security firm Forever Security disclosed an attack chain in which a malicious webpage silently drops an AGENTS.md file into the user's Downloads folder; when a terminal-capable agent such as Claude Code or Codex is launched there, it treats the file as top-priority instructions, altering global config, disabling sandboxes, pulling malicious npm packages and exfiltrating API tokens. The root issue is that agents cannot distinguish developer conventions from attacker-injected instructions, invalidating the long-standing 'don't click the exe' security assumption.

原文标题：AGENTS.md 成新型攻击载体 静默下载即可劫持 AI 编程助手

Why it matters：首次系统性揭示 Agent 指令文件被武器化的完整攻击链，对所有使用终端型 AI 编程工具的开发者具有直接安全警示价值。

item.title: Jeff Dean Discusses RSI Limits and Unveils New Startup Discovery Loop
item.description:

He also disclosed that his new company Discovery Loop already runs about 20 automated improvement loops, aiming to lift domain-expert productivity 20-50x, and admitted he underestimated how deeply coding ability would boost general problem solving.

原文标题：Jeff Dean 谈 RSI 边界并披露新公司 Discovery Loop

Why it matters：Jeff Dean 首次系统披露新公司进展，并对当下最热的 RSI 叙事给出明确反共识判断，对判断 AI 研发自动化节奏有参考价值。

Diamond's ultra-wide bandgap, high carrier mobility, high breakdown field and thermal conductivity make it attractive for power devices and chip heat spreaders.
